module_summary: AXI-stream skid/register slice built as a 2-entry shift register (SRL) with a read pointer selecting the output entry and a full flag deasserting input ready.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload packed into s_axis and shifted into data_reg[0].

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid shifted into valid_reg alongside the data.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready (not full); enables shifting data_reg and valid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload sliced from the selected entry m_axis.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid read from valid_reg at ptr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; resets ptr_reg and decides full_reg.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Two-entry shift register holding packed beats (data, last, user).

anchors.name: valid_reg
anchors.why: Per-entry valid bits shifted in parallel with data_reg.

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting which shift-register entry drives the output.

anchors.name: full_reg
anchors.why: Full flag set when output stalled; deasserts s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input bundle of tdata/tkeep/tlast/tuser fields.

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: Selected output entry unpacked to m_axis fields.

groups.name: input_port
groups.description: Packs AXI-stream input fields and gates acceptance by full flag.

groups.name: srl_buffer
groups.description: Two-entry shift register with output pointer and full flag.

groups.name: output_port
groups.description: Unpacks selected entry onto AXI-stream output fields.
